old_description: Sapona Plastics, LLC is a rapidly growing company that specializes in injection molding and assembly. about:
Sapona Plastics LLC, headquartered in Asheboro, North Carolina, was founded in April 2004 by Jack C. Lail. The company remains privately owned by the Lail family and began with ten injection molding machines near Seagrove, NC.

Today the molder operates 27 presses ranging from 33 to 720 tons, including 16 all‑electric and hybrid machines, across two facilities totaling 145,000 square feet (53,000 sq ft in Asheboro and 92,000 sq ft in Seagrove) with approximately 130 employees. Core processes include thermoplastic injection molding, insert molding, over‑molding, brush making, decorating, and assembly, supplemented by secondary operations such as hot stamping, pad printing, ultrasonic welding, fusion welding, machining, labeling, spin welding, hot‑melt gluing, foam filling, brush bristling, and heat staking. The company also provides part and mold design project management, in‑house CAD, on‑site tool maintenance, warehousing, fulfillment, and distribution, producing millions of parts and assemblies each week with annual sales exceeding $20 million.

Sapona serves the personal care, consumer goods, telecommunications, electrical, industrial, HVAC, medical, automotive, agricultural, and lighting markets. Typical products include buckets, brushes, scrubbers, fiber‑optic and cable components, filter components, electrical and lighting enclosures, control and cable enclosures, and sporting goods.

The company emphasizes a “Fast, Reliable and Cost Effective” strategy: on‑time delivery with proactive communication, early design‑for‑manufacture involvement, RJG‑certified Master Molders, cGMP‑ and ISO‑compliant quality systems, 24‑hour operation, and all‑electric presses that run up to 25% more efficiently. Recycling and post‑consumer recycled material options are also offered.
